method: Static source/bytecode/VBA control-flow review; no specimen code executed. atomscan slow/local/no-update and cleave facts run on every original sample; additional extracted sources inspected.

samples.marker_line: Identity beacon fixture: reserved example sink; fix intent overclaims
execution: index.js requires https; module-level try computes HOSTNAME/COMPUTERNAME + colon + USER/USERNAME with n fallbacks.
Buffer.from(who).toString('hex') is encoding, not decoding or encryption. The encoded identity enters the m query parameter of one HTTPS GET.
The only sink is ingest.example.net, a subdomain of an IANA-reserved documentation domain. There is no polling, command dispatch, downloaded code, persistence, or filesystem modification.
The callback ignores the response. catch(e){} catches synchronous failures only, not asynchronous ClientRequest error events.

The empty preinstall/postinstall strings do not execute a payload. main contains shell-shaped text but Node's main field is a module path, not a shell execution hook. Direct loading of index.js runs its top-level GET.
samples.verdict_evidence: The reserved destination, example scope, hollow metadata, and exact local regression-fixture identity support a synthetic test rather than an operational theft package. The real identity-to-query behavior is retained as notable.
samples.missing_context: No publication history or real deployment is supplied; no custom DNS mapping or actual victim execution is assumed.
samples.supported_losses: None: all original matched observations survive under accurate neutral names. Two hostile and two suspicious intent claims are corrected; stronger parsing additionally exposed and corrected two other overbroad hostile composites.
residual_engine_labels: supply-chain/install-hook/preinstall and postinstall still describe empty hook keys as running hooks; emitted by the package analyzer, not YAML.

samples.marker_line: Freya GUI sources: normal build and UI code; correct neutral traits
samples.identity: Freya native Rust GUI framework source snapshot; workspace version 0.5.0-beta.12
execution: crates/freya-icons/build.rs enumerates checked-out SVG icons and writes generated Rust include declarations under OUT_DIR; no network or payload execution in that build script.

The devtools application connects to ws://127.0.0.1:7354, deserializes GUI tree updates and displays them. The camera feature gate reexports the camera crate; a literal camera is not a host reconnaissance survey.

Android GradleWrapperMain bytecode parses wrapper configuration, invokes distribution installation and starts the Gradle bootstrap. Wrapper properties specify services.gradle.org Gradle 9.2.1 with distribution SHA-256 verification.

The manual release workflow installs development packages, removes CI runner toolchains, invokes the pinned release action with its configured registry token, and creates tags/releases. Those are ordinary release effects, not evidence of token theft.

The hotpath relay forwards benchmark JSON using a hotpath.rs-audience OIDC token. It downloads reports without checking out pull-request code. The flagged documentation explains GitHub withholding write/OIDC tokens from forks.
samples.verdict_evidence: Build logic, native UI components, local development tooling and configured benchmark publication match the documented GUI framework purpose. No concrete hostile path was established.
samples.missing_context: This unpinned HEAD archive is not a signed release and its full snapshot was not authenticated against an immutable upstream commit. Public project identity corroborates purpose, not every byte.
samples.supported_losses: None in original archive members or the isolated hotpath dependency. Camera and token prose observations remain notable in correct metadata homes.

dependency_review.isolated_atomscan_before_after: BENIGN -> BENIGN; 0 hostile / 0 suspicious -> 0 / 0; raw probability 0.646487 unchanged
dependency_review.provenance: forager fetched the versioned GitHub archive with its .forage.json record under scratch/reasoned-review/hotpath; docs and relay source reviewed directly.
dependency_review.correction: read-secret-before-send-phrase retains the original prose matcher and its exact consumers. No dependent-package exception was introduced.

samples.marker_line: FormSG 4.48.0: forms app and Outlook importer; fix traits, add file IO
samples.identity: FormSG 4.48.0 government forms application source distribution
execution: The Node/TypeScript backend provides authenticated form administration, OTP sign-in, submission handling, database persistence and configured email delivery. Frontend code sends multipart or encrypted submissions to relative form API routes.

The FormSG_Script_v1-4.xlsm VBA was extracted with oletools and independently inspected in cleave facts. Only Formsg_Script contains a Sub; ThisWorkbook and FormSG have class attributes without auto-open handlers.

The user-triggered macro reads workbook configuration, opens a selected Outlook folder, parses matching formsg-auto messages' HTML tables, saves attachments beneath Documents/formsg, refreshes existing per-submission attachment directories and saves a new output workbook. WScript.Shell is used only to resolve MyDocuments; there is no shell Run/Exec call or macro network export.

The installation DOCX embeds an OLE object whose Ole10Native stream contains bitmap data (BM header), not executable code. Its cid: image relationship is a content reference, not a remote template fetch.
MongoDB stop occurs in test teardown after dropDatabase/close on a MongoMemoryServer instance. The Elastic Beanstalk cron job publishes memory/disk metrics using the AWS CloudWatch monitoring script.

VBA signature sidecars vbaProjectSignature.bin and vbaProjectSignatureAgile.bin are conventional signatures, not renamed project payloads. Long descriptive VBA names alone do not establish obfuscation.
samples.verdict_evidence: Form APIs, configured mail transport, documented Outlook aggregation and deployment/test scripts form a coherent legitimate application. The Office macro and file deletion are real dual-use capabilities and remain detected.
samples.missing_context: No production deployment, user authorization records or complete authenticated release provenance is supplied. The verdict concerns these source bytes and supplied packaging.
samples.supported_losses: No attack coverage loss in the tested controls. The only unmatched notable observation after mapping is ooxml-vba-nonstandard-part on standard signature sidecars; an actual renamed VBA project control still matches.
residual_engine_labels: objectives/execution/interpreter::template-injection is emitted at notable for the ordinary cid: image by cleave/src/analyzers/office/mod.rs. YAML cannot correct this built-in ID without an engine change.
supply-chain/suspicious-package labels axios-mock-adapter, a declared development test dependency. This is also analyzer output, not a YAML rule.

matcher_preservation: Except the corrected MkDir statement matcher and broadened SaveAsFile reference matcher, all relocated matcher predicates and scopes are unchanged. Consumers were updated. Six overbroad HTTP co-occurrence composites now state neutral observations.
directory_review: The key/value leaf was reviewed at its 100-rule budget; its cross-construct ping/heartbeat-or-check_redirect alternative moved to source/shape without changing matching, making room for the correctly placed recipient field. COM object imports were placed with instantiation rather than process creation. No directory budgets were raised.
additional_coverage: Structured direct empty-arrow GET callback, including nested URL encoding calls
Module-level HTTPS GET raised from baseline to notable
SaveAsFile object-method references, including attachment variables and parenthesized calls
VB SaveAs with named FileName argument
comparison_scope: Original archive bytes and member paths were stable. Mutable fetched registry metadata refreshed, and fetched GitHub web content acquired one extra decoded layer; those changes are not attributed to YAML. No hostile/suspicious finding appeared anywhere in the reviewed after trees.
remaining_disagreements: Freya and FormSG remain ML HOSTILE despite reasoned BENIGN judgments and zero hostile/suspicious traits. The model bundle reports feature-spec v18 while this engine expects v21. Engine-generated CID-image, inert-hook and package-name labels need producer corrections, not YAML shadows.

intent_corrections.node-env-hex-identity-query-exfil: Host/user reads, hex encoding and GET are co-occurring observations; the matcher does not bind the identity to the query or establish unauthorized transfer. The reviewed sample is a reserved-domain regression fixture. Retained unchanged as notable telemetry context.
intent_corrections.suppressed-error-import-time-beacon: A single load-time GET near an empty catch proves neither repeated beaconing nor a control channel. The catch does not swallow asynchronous request errors. Retained unchanged as notable GET/catch context.
intent_corrections.depconf-bare-import-beacon: No dependencies and a high version, simple description or placeholder claim do not establish dependency confusion or attacker ownership of a destination. The required imported call need not be the GET. Retained unchanged as notable package context.
intent_corrections.depconf-import-time-identity-beacon: Archive co-occurrence of a user environment reference, GET, import call and catch establishes neither data flow nor a dependency-selection attack. Retained unchanged as notable context.
intent_corrections.fire-and-forget-https-beacon: Discarding a response with a nearby empty catch also occurs in ordinary telemetry. There is no required recurrence, operator control or secret source. Retained unchanged as notable response/catch context.
intent_corrections.npm-load-time-https-beacon-silent-errors: A module-level call does not make the response-discard pattern supply-chain compromise or theft; synchronous catches do not suppress all request errors. Retained unchanged as notable load/catch context.

narrowing_and_expansion_evidence.ooxml-vba-nonstandard-part: Standard signature and Agile/V3 signature names are excluded, while nonstandard VBA code paths remain matched. The actual signed FormSG workbook no longer fires; the same actual VBA project renamed to code.c still does.
narrowing_and_expansion_evidence.vba-mkdir: The old literal matcher matched quoted MkDir text instead of a statement. The relocated directory-creation matcher requires a statement at line start, preserving real execution evidence and excluding quoted/commented mentions.
narrowing_and_expansion_evidence.object-saveasfile-reference: The original Item(1) method-reference form is preserved; direct attachment variables and other numeric indices are now also covered. The name says reference rather than asserting a save was observed.
narrowing_and_expansion_evidence.node-http-get-empty-arrow-callback: Structured call/argument matching preserves a direct empty response callback and accepts nested encoding calls. An empty chained error handler and a nonempty response callback are tested near misses.
